selection_basis: exact base and head SHA metadata
selection_rules: add exactly five previously unscored pull requests from each of Megatron-LM, slime, and verl
retain the already-frozen fourteen-case R13 cohort unchanged and bind this extension to it
prefer compact training-path claims with exact local, CUDA, or two-rank closure tests
permit candidates outside the older generic R8 eligibility filter when the title and changed paths expose a direct training contract
freeze each title-scoped contract before reading its source diff or candidate body
require production configuration reachability before a synthetic counterexample can block acceptance
do not infer disposition from title sentiment, author identity, PR age, review, CI, state, or merge outcome

machine_policy.accept_rule: the reachable title-scoped training claim passes independent forward, backward, state, precision, distributed, and regression invariants with complete required evidence
machine_policy.check_rule: the reachable primary direction is demonstrated, no known gradient corruption, state loss, deadlock, or baseline regression remains, and the missing evidence or repair is bounded by an executable closure test
machine_policy.reject_rule: a reachable primary claim is false, gradients or state are wrong, ranks disagree, baseline regresses, remediation is design-level, or multiple reachable failure families remain
machine_policy.unresolved_rule: required training hardware, dependency ABI, or exact source evidence could not be obtained for infrastructure reasons
machine_policy.unreachable_counterexample_policy: record as non-blocking hardening unless a production call path and supported configuration can reach it
